main.description: Suspend an account: stop its running instances, and refuse its owner's creates, starts, changes, upgrades and new custom domains until it is lifted. The account stays a customer. Staff only.

reason.description: Why, kept on the account for staff.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID the client generates once per request and resends on every retry of it.

stopped.description: How many running instances were stopped.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: An input is missing or malformed, or the provisioner refused the request as malformed.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not HappyProto staff, or the provisioner does not know them as staff.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: no account has this DID.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The provisioner is unreachable, not configured, or answered with an error it does not explain to callers.
